summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to announce a quarterly common share dividend increase of $0.96 per share (up $0.04 from the prior quarter), payable June 30, 2026, and dividends on its Class A Non-Cumulative Preferred Shares. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation; it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other notable corporate event. There are no deal terms, as it is a standard capital allocation disclosure. The filing provides no strategic corporate changes, board recommendations, or advisors. What to watch: none, as it is an ordinary earnings-related dividend update.
